001package com.streamConverter.examples;
002
003import com.streamConverter.CommandResult;
004import com.streamConverter.api.StreamBuilder;
005import com.streamConverter.api.Streams;
006import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
007import java.io.IOException;
008import java.util.List;
009import org.slf4j.Logger;
010import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
011
012/**
013 * 流暢なAPI（Fluent API）のデモンストレーション
014 *
015 * <p>新しいStreamBuilderとStreams APIの使用例を示します。 従来のコマンド配列による記述と比較して、より直感的で読みやすい
016 * メソッドチェーンによる処理パイプラインの構築方法を紹介します。
017 */
018public class FluentApiDemo {
019
020  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(FluentApiDemo.class);
021
022  /**
023   * Fluent APIデモのメインメソッド
024   *
025   * @param args コマンドライン引数（使用されません）
026   */
027  public static void main(String[] args) {
028    logger.info("🌊 StreamConverter - Fluent API Demo");
029    logger.info("=====================================\n");
030
031    try {
032      // Demo 1: Basic StreamBuilder usage
033      basicStreamBuilderDemo();
034
035      // Demo 2: Data format specific APIs
036      dataFormatSpecificDemo();
037
038      // Demo 3: Complex pipeline construction
039      complexPipelineDemo();
040
041      // Demo 4: Conditional processing
042      conditionalProcessingDemo();
043
044      // Demo 5: Comparison with traditional approach
045      comparisonDemo();
046
047    } catch (Exception e) {
048      logger.error("Demo failed: " + e.getMessage());
049      e.printStackTrace();
050    }
051  }
052
053  /** Demo 1: 基本的なStreamBuilderの使用法 */
054  private static void basicStreamBuilderDemo() throws IOException {
055    logger.info("🔧 Basic StreamBuilder Usage");
056    logger.info("==============================");
057
058    String employeeData =
059        "employee_id,name,department,salary\n"
060            + "E001,John Smith,Engineering,75000\n"
061            + "E002,Jane Doe,Marketing,65000\n"
062            + "E003,Bob Johnson,Engineering,80000";
063
064    // 流暢なAPIでCSV処理
065    String result =
066        StreamBuilder.create()
067            .fromString(employeeData)
068            .extractCsv("name")
069            .process("name-formatter")
070            .asString();
071
072    logger.info("📋 Employee names extracted:");
073    logger.info(result);
074
075    // パイプライン情報を表示
076    StreamBuilder pipeline =
077        StreamBuilder.create()
078            .fromString(employeeData)
079            .extractCsv("department")
080            .process("department-analyzer");
081
082    logger.info("\n🔍 Pipeline structure:");
083    logger.info(pipeline.getPipelineInfo());
084
085    logger.info("Commands count: {}", pipeline.getCommandCount());
086    logger.info("Is empty: {}", pipeline.isEmpty());
087
088    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
089  }
090
091  /** Demo 2: データフォーマット特化API */
092  private static void dataFormatSpecificDemo() throws IOException {
093    logger.info("📊 Data Format Specific APIs");
094    logger.info("==============================");
095
096    // JSON処理の例
097    String jsonData =
098        """
099            {
100                "user": {
101                    "id": 123,
102                    "name": "John Doe",
103                    "email": "john@example.com",
104                    "active": true
105                },
106                "timestamp": "2023-07-31T10:00:00Z"
107            }
108            """;
109
110    logger.info("🟢 JSON Processing:");
111    String jsonResult = Streams.json(jsonData).extract("user").format().asString();
112    logger.info(jsonResult);
113
114    // CSV処理の例
115    String csvData =
116        "product_id,name,price,category\n"
117            + "P001,Laptop,999.99,Electronics\n"
118            + "P002,Chair,149.99,Furniture";
119
120    logger.info("\n🟡 CSV Processing:");
121    String csvResult = Streams.csv(csvData).extract("price").process("price-formatter").asString();
122    logger.info(csvResult);
123
124    // XML処理の例
125    String xmlData =
126        """
127            <?xml version="1.0"?>
128            <configuration>
129                <database>
130                    <host>localhost</host>
131                    <port>5432</port>
132                </database>
133            </configuration>
134            """;
135
136    logger.info("\n🟠 XML Processing:");
137    String xmlResult =
138        Streams.xml(xmlData).extract("configuration/database").process("config-parser").asString();
139    logger.info(xmlResult);
140
141    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
142  }
143
144  /** Demo 3: 複雑なパイプライン構築 */
145  private static void complexPipelineDemo() throws IOException {
146    logger.info("⚙️ Complex Pipeline Construction");
147    logger.info("==================================");
148
149    String apiResponse =
150        """
151            {
152                "status": "success",
153                "data": {
154                    "users": [
155                        {"id": 1, "name": "John", "email": "john@example.com"},
156                        {"id": 2, "name": "Jane", "email": "jane@example.com"}
157                    ]
158                }
159            }
160            """;
161
162    // 複雑な処理パイプライン
163    try (ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
164      List<CommandResult> results =
165          StreamBuilder.create()
166              .fromString(apiResponse)
167              .formatJson() // JSONフォーマット
168              .extractJson("data") // データ部分抽出
169              .process("user-analyzer") // ユーザー分析
170              .convertEncoding("UTF-8", "UTF-16") // エンコーディング変換
171              .convertEncoding("UTF-16", "UTF-8") // 元に戻す
172              .process("final-formatter") // 最終フォーマット
173              .toStream(outputStream);
174
175      logger.info("🔄 Complex pipeline executed successfully");
176      logger.info("Commands executed: {}", results.size());
177      logger.info(
178          "Output preview: {}",
179          outputStream.toString().substring(0, Math.min(100, outputStream.toString().length()))
180              + "...");
181    }
182
183    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
184  }
185
186  /** Demo 4: 条件付き処理 */
187  private static void conditionalProcessingDemo() throws IOException {
188    logger.info("🔀 Conditional Processing");
189    logger.info("===========================");
190
191    String configData =
192        """
193            {
194                "environment": "production",
195                "debug": false,
196                "features": {
197                    "logging": true,
198                    "metrics": true
199                }
200            }
201            """;
202
203    boolean isProduction = true;
204    boolean enableMetrics = true;
205
206    // 条件付きパイプライン構築
207    String result =
208        StreamBuilder.create()
209            .fromString(configData)
210            .formatJson()
211            .when(isProduction, builder -> builder.process("production-validator"))
212            .extractJson("features")
213            .when(enableMetrics, builder -> builder.process("metrics-collector"))
214            .process("config-processor")
215            .asString();
216
217    logger.info("🎯 Conditional pipeline result:");
218    logger.info(result);
219
220    // パイプライン構築の情報を表示
221    StreamBuilder conditionalPipeline =
222        StreamBuilder.create()
223            .fromString(configData)
224            .formatJson()
225            .when(false, builder -> builder.process("skipped-command")) // スキップされる
226            .when(true, builder -> builder.process("executed-command")) // 実行される
227            .extractJson("environment");
228
229    logger.info("\n📋 Conditional pipeline structure:");
230    logger.info(conditionalPipeline.getPipelineInfo());
231
232    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
233  }
234
235  /** Demo 5: 従来のアプローチとの比較 */
236  private static void comparisonDemo() throws IOException {
237    logger.info("⚖️ Traditional vs Fluent API Comparison");
238    logger.info("=========================================");
239
240    String sampleData =
241        """
242            {
243                "message": "Hello, StreamConverter!",
244                "version": "2.0"
245            }
246            """;
247
248    logger.info("📝 Traditional approach (verbose):");
249    logger.info("   IStreamCommand[] commands = {");
250    logger.info("       new JsonNavigateCommand(\"message\"),");
251    logger.info("       new SampleStreamCommand(\"processor\")");
252    logger.info("   };");
253    logger.info("   StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(commands);");
254    logger.info("   converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);");
255
256    logger.info("\n✨ Fluent API approach (concise):");
257    logger.info("   String result = Streams.json(data)");
258    logger.info("       .extract(\"message\")");
259    logger.info("       .process(\"processor\")");
260    logger.info("       .asString();");
261
262    // 実際に実行して結果を比較
263    String fluentResult =
264        Streams.json(sampleData).extract("message").process("message-processor").asString();
265
266    logger.info("\n🎯 Fluent API result:");
267    logger.info(fluentResult);
268
269    logger.info("\n💡 Benefits of Fluent API:");
270    logger.info("   ✓ More readable and intuitive");
271    logger.info("   ✓ Type-safe method chaining");
272    logger.info("   ✓ Conditional processing support");
273    logger.info("   ✓ Built-in pipeline introspection");
274    logger.info("   ✓ Reduced boilerplate code");
275
276    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
277  }
278}
